cognitive-complexity-rule.desc: Verifies that every function has a SonarQube cognitive complexity score below a maximum.

scoring.structural: +1 (plus the current nesting depth) for each `if`, `match`, `for`, `while`, `loop`, and `let ... else`. The nesting depth increases inside their bodies (for `let ... else`, inside the diverging block), so the same construct costs more the deeper it sits.
scoring.macros: +1 (plus the current nesting depth) for each call to a macro that branches. Macro bodies are opaque to the parser, so these are recognized by name from a fixed list, currently `matches!` and `assert_matches!`. Every other macro costs nothing, and nothing inside any macro is scored.
scoring.hybrid: +1 (with no nesting penalty) for each `else if` and `else`.
scoring.nesting-only: Closures and nested functions add no increment of their own but do increase the nesting depth for the code inside them.
scoring.flat: +1 for each labeled `break`/`continue`, and +1 for each sequence of like boolean operators, where a change of operator starts a new sequence.

cognitive-complexity-rule.config: - max: maximum cognitive complexity allowed per function (default 8) - ignore: list of functions to skip. A file path followed by `::` and the function or `Type::method` (e.g. `src/main.rs::run`, `src/main.rs::Config::new`)
